name: auth-bff-starter
description: Base template: React SPA + BFF, authenticated via any OIDC provider (Authorization Code + PKCE).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n bff,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w bff" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w bff
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w bff && npm run typecheck -w frontend
